papers.title: Approximating Full Conformal Prediction for Neural Network Regression with Gauss-Newton Influence
papers.abstract: Uncertainty quantification is an important prerequisite for the deployment of deep learning models in safety-critical areas. Yet, this hinges on the uncertainty estimates being useful to the extent the prediction intervals are well-calibrated and sharp. In the absence of inherent uncertainty estimates (e.g. pretrained models predicting only point estimates), popular approaches that operate post-hoc include Laplace's method and split conformal prediction (split-CP). However, Laplace's method can be miscalibrated when the model is misspecified and split-CP requires sample splitting, and thus comes at the expense of statistical efficiency. In this work, we construct prediction intervals for neural network regressors post-hoc without held-out data. This is achieved by approximating the full conformal prediction method (full-CP). Whilst full-CP nominally requires retraining the model for every test point and candidate label, we propose to train just once and locally perturb model parameters using Gauss-Newton influence to approximate the effect of retraining. Coupled with linearization of the network, we express the absolute residual nonconformity score as a piecewise linear function of the candidate label allowing for an efficient procedure that avoids the exhaustive search over the output space. On standard regression benchmarks and bounding box localization, we show the resulting prediction intervals are locally-adaptive and often tighter than those of split-CP.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无需留出数据的全共形预测近似方法，可应用于神经网络回归的不确定性量化，对代理模型中的预测区间构建具有参考价值。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design context; it focuses on general neural network regression uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 为神经网络回归提供无需留出数据的后验不确定性量化方法。

summary_zh.result: 预测区间具有局部自适应性，且通常比分裂共形预测更紧。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准回归基准和边界框定位任务上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable post-hoc uncertainty quantification for neural network regressors without requiring held-out data.
summary_en.method: Approximate full conformal prediction by perturbing model parameters using Gauss-Newton influence, avoiding retraining for each test point.
summary_en.result: The resulting prediction intervals are locally adaptive and often tighter than those from split conformal prediction.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard regression benchmarks and bounding box localization tasks.
